words: Why your street is hotter than the park
So the street outside my flat is three degrees hotter than the park next to it.
Three whole degrees, a two-minute walk apart.
Which is the whole point of today's episode: shade is infrastructure.
Like roads, or water pipes. Something a city has to build on purpose.
And right now most cities are building it by accident, if at all.
Let's start with how heat actually gets trapped between buildings.
Picture the street as a canyon made of stone and glass...
